operations.title: Nima corrects deck readout to paired mixed variance
operations.body: Typing correction after the branch audit: the physical deck readout is not one function algebra with covariant transfer. For q:G->H, coefficients pull back q^*:Fun(H)->Fun(G), Betti cycles push forward q_*:Q[G]->Q[H], and the source-compatible law is <q^*c,Gamma>_G=<c,q_*Gamma>_H. Fiber-sum q_! remains the dual algebraic transfer and the Beck-Chevalley result stands, but it does not alone repair physical selection variance. Entry 1224 supplies only the set quotient; the missing test is its lift to q_* on relative chains. Packet: research/nima/deck-readout-variance-correction.md; graph event 1131.
